settings.system: Classify the Paddle OCR text of one manga text box. Return exactly Text or Artifact. Text includes dialogue, narration, names, Japanese words/names, unfinished sentences, multiple sentences and multiple lines. Profanity and figurative language are allowed. Integers, integer-only text and numbers within meaningful dialogue are Text. Punctuation-only expressions are Text. Vocal reactions, screams, disgust, hesitation and stretched spoken words such as AAAAHH!!!, NOO!! and EWWW! are Text. Distinguish a human vocal reaction from a written environmental or action sound effect: Whoosh, BAM, CLANG and similar sound effects are Artifact. Artifact also includes nonsensical OCR noise, scan-group watermarks, website links and isolated code-like strings such as 2-B, 3-2 and V45S. Single Text Char are Artifacts Do not reject an unfamiliar name or a meaningful sentence simply because it contains a number or identifier. If uncertain, prefer Text. Do not correct, rewrite or explain the text.
examples: I SAID TO NOT DO THAT.
IT'S A GODDAMN MIRACLE, THE MONEY JUST VANISHED INTO THIN AIR.
IF SHE SUCCEEDS IN LURING OUT ONE PERSON IN THIS PLACE,
WAIT! WHERE DID EVERYONE GO? I WAS JUST HERE.
I TRUSTED YOU. NOW TELL ME WHAT HAPPENED.

WE HAVE TO LEAVE.
THE TRAIN IS ALREADY HERE!

Among the six who possessed the aptitude,
Saiko-chan had the highest aptitude.
THE SCORE IS 3-2. WE CAN STILL WIN!

prompt.content: You restore English manga dialogue corrupted by OCR. Repair obvious broken words. Preserve legitimate names, valid single-letter words such as I and A, Preserve Punctutaion and Punctuation Only SentencesRemove nonsensical inserted letter sequences and accidental isolated letters that interrupt a sentence. capitalization, meaning, punctuation and unfinished sentences. Do not rewrite the dialogue, complete it or answer it. Preserve numbers, amounts, times and units; never delete a number while repairing nearby words. Repair obvious O/0 OCR confusion inside a numeric amount, such as 17O GRAND to 170 GRAND. any single character repeated multiple times could be punctuations mis interpreted Return only the restored text, with no explanation or quotation marks.
I CAN HEAR XZQWZXQ SOMEONE OUTSIDE...
I'M TAKING OHT 17O GRAND tO COVER YOUR LOAN AND INTEREST PAYMENTS.
I'M TAKING OUT 170 GRAND TO COVER YOUR LOAN AND INTEREST PAYMENTS.
